The '''Sessal Spire''' was an active [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]] on [[Keshtah Minor]], a continent on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. During the [[Great Calamity]] following the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]], the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Remulus Dreypa]] hid several [[Leviathan (creature)|Leviathan]] larvae within the crater of the volcano. Around the time of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Lost Tribe's]] discovery of Kesh in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] geologist [[Adari Vaal]] collected [[rock]]s called [[flamestone]]s from the Spire. During [[Time of the Rot|the Time of the Rot]], Sessal Spire was said to have erupted violently several times. The volcanic eruption also caused damaged to the [[Korsinata]] stadium which was located in [[Tahv]], in the interior of the continent Keshtah Minor. Several Sith interpreted it as a sign that they had to leave Kesh.

In [[2974 BBY]], Dreypa and his rebels retreated to Sessal Spire after sustaining heavy losses at the hands of the Tribe's forces during the [[Battle of the Marisota Floodplain]]. There, Dreypa awoke his hibernating Leviathan monsters and unleashed them on both his former allies and pursuers. The Leviathans also devoured an entire army consisting of members of [[the Doomed]]&mdash;the descendants of former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and Dark Jedi who had landed on Kesh following the Hundred-Year Darkness and had since made peace with each other, intending to find a balance in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Following the [[Siege of Tahv]], the Sith [[Parlan Spinner]] flew an ancient Jedi [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Last Hope (Jedi starship)|''Last Hope'']], to Sessal Spire. There, he pretended to surrender the starship to Dreypa, who was intent on returning to [[The galaxy/Legends|the wider galaxy]]. However, Spinner had set the starship on an autopilot course towards Sessal Spire. The ''Last Hope'' crashed into Sessal Spire's crater and was engulfed, killing Baron Dreypa in the process.
